purpose: New falsifiable mechanism: fixed strict root tie priority allows skipping equality resolution only when the action cannot beat selected repetition/priority. Any potential winner still full-window verified. Every permutation tested against explicit exact best set; uniform permutation yields uniform selection among true optimum ties. This differs from legacy reservoir seeded trajectories and requires separate optional policy/settings, not a drop-in exact-seed optimization. No production option/adoption/performance/strength screen. This prototype accepts a complete explicit root action order; RNG generation/validation/worker/budget semantics not formalized.
proof: At root an equal fail-low upper bound implies true score<=selected score. If repetition preference is worse, or equal and fixed priority worse, no possible true score can replace selected. Otherwise retain full verification. Strict total priority is fixed independently of scores and aspiration retries; the earliest member of the true best score/minimum-repetition subset in a uniform permutation is uniform over that subset.
